mapper.sql: f."図形ID", f."図形番号", f."教科", f."図形種別", f."登録区分", f."図形名", f."メモ", f."タグ", f."表示順", f."状態コード", f."バージョン", f."登録者アカウントID", f."更新者アカウントID", f."登録日時", f."更新日時", (f."サムネイル画像" IS NOT NULL AND f."サムネイル画像" <> '') AS "hasThumbnail", length(COALESCE(f."GeoGebraXML", '')) AS "constructionLength"
f."図形ID", f."図形番号", f."教科", f."図形種別", f."登録区分", f."図形名", f."メモ", f."タグ", f."GeoGebraXML", f."サムネイル画像", f."表示順", f."状態コード", f."バージョン", f."登録元コード", f."登録者アカウントID", f."更新者アカウントID", f."登録日時", f."更新日時"

where.if: AND (f."図形名" ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(f."メモ", '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(f."タグ", '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM public."GEO_図形情報" f

SELECT FROM public."GEO_図形情報" f
ORDER BY
f."登録日時" DESC NULLS LAST, f."図形ID" DESC f."図形名" ASC, f."表示順" ASC, f."図形ID" ASC f."更新日時" DESC NULLS LAST, f."図形ID" DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE f."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE') AS "figureCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE' AND f."図形種別" = 'geometry') AS "geometryCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE' AND f."図形種別" = 'function') AS "functionCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f."状態コード" = 'DELETED') AS "deletedCount" FROM public."GEO_図形情報" f

SELECT btrim(tag) AS "tag", count(*) AS "tagCount" FROM public."GEO_図形情報" f, regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(f."タグ", ''), '\|') AS tag WHERE btrim(tag) <> ''
AND f."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY btrim(tag) ORDER BY count(*) DESC, btrim(tag) ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT "図形ID" AS "figureId", "図形番号" AS "figureNo" FROM public."GEO_図形情報" WHERE "図形番号" = #{figureNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(max(f."表示順"), 0) + 1 FROM public."GEO_図形情報" f
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."GEO_図形情報" ( "図形番号", "教科", "図形種別", "登録区分", "図形名", "メモ", "タグ", "GeoGebraXML", "サムネイル画像", "表示順", "状態コード", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{figureNo}, #{subject}, #{figureType}, #{kind}, #{title}, #{memo}, #{tags}, #{construction}, #{thumbnail}, #{displayOrder}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdBy}, COALESCE(#{sourceCode}, 'APP') )
mapper.update: UPDATE public."GEO_図形情報" SET "図形名" = #{title}, "図形種別" = #{figureType}, "メモ" = #{memo}, "タグ" = #{tags}, "GeoGebraXML" = #{construction}, "サムネイル画像" = #{thumbnail}, "更新者アカウントID" = #{updatedBy}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "図形ID" = #{figureId} AND "バージョン" = #{version}

UPDATE public."GEO_図形情報" SET "表示順" = #{displayOrder}, "更新者アカウントID" = #{operator}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "図形ID" = #{figureId} AND "バージョン" = #{version}
UPDATE public."GEO_図形情報" SET "状態コード" = 'DELETED', "更新者アカウントID" = #{operator}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "図形ID" = #{figureId}
